remarks: Discover the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm at 11 River Road, Unit 105. Ideally located in the heart of Cos Cob, this beautifully maintained condo offers effortless waterfront living, minutes from the train, local shops, restaurants and all the amenities that make this neighborhood so desirable. This bright and inviting residence features an open-concept layout with large sliders that fill the space with natural light. The living and dining areas flow seamlessly, making the home ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Two private outdoor balconies provide additional space to relax.The kitchen offers functional workspace with ample cabinetry, stone countertops and quality appliances. The bedrooms are generously sized.  Residents enjoy one assigned and one unassigned parking spot in the garage below the unit and a storage unit. The location is unmatched!
